title: ACES AcceptanceBinding
description: Machine-readable shape for the fixed Minimal ACES Acceptance Protocol acceptance binding. This schema does not authorize acceptance by itself.

canonical_ref.description: Reference to the canonical reality being transitioned.

authority_ref.description: Reference to the authority domain responsible for acceptance.

capability_ref.description: Reference to the delegated right permitting the acceptance action.

policy_ref.description: Reference to the policy/version governing admissibility.

verification_context_ref.description: Reference binding acceptance to the exact verification context.
